key_points: Allspring (former WFC asset management arm) exploring sale, but talks early and no decision made
Majority of headlines are generic market commentary or Wells Fargo research views on other stocks (NFLX, DIS, S&P 500)
No WFC-specific earnings, guidance, regulatory, M&A, or management news
Valuation articles note 125% 3-year run but offer no new fundamental catalyst
Allspring sale could have residual implications for WFC if economics remain, but too early to assess
